screen.luxium.config.hover_hint: HOVER OVER A SETTING TO SEE DETAILS
description.luxium.opaque_ice: Option for increasing FPS in frozen biomes, or where there is a lot of ice, in short transparent ice kills FPS. The gain depends on your PC.
tooltip.luxium.opaque_ice_enabled: OFF leaves transparent ice, ON enables opaque ice, that's all
tooltip.luxium.rtx_enabled: Bro this is an UNFINISHED system and most likely will be cut. But if you're interested - this system replaces the vanilla light propagation system with a more realistic one, unplayable, I don't even remember whether it works normally at all XDDD
tooltip.luxium.rtx_lava_tracing_enabled: Enables/disables that lighting system for lava, better disable it because tracing 100500 lava blocks is not cool
tooltip.luxium.entity_shadows_enabled: Enables/disables shadows from entities, also this slider affects the entity shadow in NeoCPU and legacy modes. Don't ask why...
tooltip.luxium.rtx_world_tracing_workers: Exact number of background NeoFlood solver threads. 1 means exactly one active background solver, not the whole CPU. Higher values process chunk lights faster but increase CPU pressure.
tooltip.luxium.flood_radius_cap: Maximum distance to which light can propagate from a source.
tooltip.luxium.flood_penumbra_softness: In short this is shadow softness
tooltip.luxium.flood_corner_seal: Controls mixed lit/dark interpolation footprints at occluder edges.
tooltip.luxium.flood_update_budget: Maximum number of world sources granted to one background batch. Batches start no more often than once every 50 ms and are also capped by World Trace Workers. Lower values prioritize smooth chunk loading; higher values settle background lighting faster.
tooltip.luxium.realistic_shadows_enabled:
NOT RELEVANT
Cuts RTX block light by projecting solid occluder shadows onto visible block faces instead of sampling per-cell grids.
tooltip.luxium.neo_cpu_shadows_enabled:
NOT RELEVANT
Enables the new source-local CPU shadow engine. It uses cached chunk section VoxelShape geometry to build projected shadows quickly, and when Entity Shadows is also enabled it hands entity/block-entity shadows over to NeoCPU instead of the simple Torch RTX occlusion path.
tooltip.luxium.gpu_shadows_enabled: Renders nearby emissive blocks as colored local lights directly in terrain and entity shaders. Choose Fast Spread for low-end GPUs or a cubemap mode for precise point-light shadows.
tooltip.luxium.entity_shadow_update_fps: Maximum update rate for moving entity and block-entity shadow casters. This does not affect Fast Spread because it performs no dynamic cubemap capture.
tooltip.luxium.realistic_shadows_render_: Resolution scale for the legacy/NeoCPU shadowless scene capture. Direct GPU Local Shadows do not use this setting.
tooltip.luxium.sky_light_sun_zenith_colo: Direct sunlight color when the Sun is high in the sky.
tooltip.luxium.sky_light_sun_zenith_stre: Base direct-light strength at high solar elevation, before Sun Light Strength is applied.
tooltip.luxium.sky_light_sunset_color: Direct sunlight color near sunrise and sunset.
tooltip.luxium.sky_light_sunset_strength: Base direct-light strength near the horizon, before Sun Light Strength is applied.
tooltip.luxium.sky_light_moon_base_stren: Base direct-light strength from the Moon, before Moon Light Strength is applied.
tooltip.luxium.sky_light_enabled: Shadows from the sun and moon, and light of course XD
tooltip.luxium.sky_light_colors_enabled: Tints blocks and entities with dynamic Sun, sunset, Moon, sky, and ground colors. Disabling this keeps celestial lighting active but neutral white.
tooltip.luxium.realistic_shadow_temperat: Makes shadows more realistic, meaning the shadow color is almost opposite to the light color.
tooltip.luxium.shadow_temperature_streng: Controls the strength of the automatic opposite-temperature shadow effect. 0 disables the automatic shift; 1 applies it fully.
tooltip.luxium.shadow_temperature_bias: Shifts the shadow temperature. 100 is cold, -100 is warm.
tooltip.luxium.sky_sun_light_strength: Intensity of emitted direct sunlight. Range: 0-200%.
tooltip.luxium.sky_moon_light_strength: Intensity of emitted direct moonlight. Range: 0-200%.
tooltip.luxium.sky_ambient_light_strengt: Intensity of soft hemispheric sky and ground ambient light. Range: 0-200%.
tooltip.luxium.vanilla_block_light_in_su: Controls how much vanilla torch and lamp block light remains visible inside sky shadows
tooltip.luxium.sky_shadow_ray_length: Minimum caster distance. Also controls entity-shadow depth; terrain and clouds extend automatically.
tooltip.luxium.sky_shadow_near_update_in: How often near shadows are rebuilt
tooltip.luxium.sky_shadow_far_update_ms: How often far shadows are rebuilt
tooltip.luxium.sky_cloud_shadows_enabled: Renders vanilla clouds into shadow maps. Cloud shadow motion follows the configured shadow update intervals.
tooltip.luxium.sky_entity_shadows_enable: Renders entities only into a separate frequently updated celestial shadow map.
tooltip.luxium.sky_entity_shadow_update_: Maximum entity shadow-map updates per second. MAX updates every rendered frame.
tooltip.luxium.sky_bake_update_interval: Minimum pause after a full sky bake finishes before the next one can start. Range: 0.1-2.0 seconds.
tooltip.luxium.sky_bake_smooth_enabled: Splits cubemap faces into smaller tiles and spreads the bake across frames to reduce visible stalls.
tooltip.luxium.sky_bake_work_per_frame: How much work to do each frame: whole faces when splitting is off, or tiles when Smooth Baking is on. Higher = faster updates but a higher stall risk.
tooltip.luxium.sky_bake_tile_size: 512 / 256 / 128 px. Smaller tiles reduce stalls but increase the time needed for a full bake. If a bake takes longer than the selected interval, actual sky updates will be slower than that interval.
tooltip.luxium.sky_sun_size: Controls vanilla sun disc size in sky rendering.
tooltip.luxium.sky_moon_size: Controls vanilla moon disc size in sky rendering.
tooltip.luxium.reflection_enabled: Fully enables or disables the reflection renderer. WORKS ONLY ON IRON BLOCK, QUARTZ BLOCKS, AND POLISHED ANDESITE
tooltip.luxium.reflection_bilinear_filte: Smooths reflection pixels. Enable it to remove visible pixelation; disable it for sharp pixel edges.
tooltip.luxium.reflection_scan_interval: How often the mirror-scan updates (5–5000 ms). Larger values reduce CPU, but newly visible mirror surfaces can appear with a delay.
tooltip.luxium.posteffects_render_scale: Shared render scale for fog, Sky God Rays, Sky Volumetric God Rays and lens flare. Lower values reduce GPU cost but soften these effects. Tonemap remains full resolution. 1.00x is full quality.
tooltip.luxium.kawase_bloom_enabled: Applies isolated Dual Kawase bloom only to visible blocks whose current state emits vanilla block light.
tooltip.luxium.kawase_bloom_intensity: Final additive strength of the blurred block-light source mask.
tooltip.luxium.kawase_bloom_radius: Sample offset used by each Dual Kawase downsample and upsample pass.
tooltip.luxium.kawase_bloom_levels: Number of downsample levels. Higher values spread bloom farther and add two filter passes per level.
tooltip.luxium.kawase_bloom_threshold: Minimum normalized vanilla block emission accepted as a bloom source.
tooltip.luxium.kawase_bloom_source_dista: Radius of the camera-centred GPU source volume. Sources outside it do not bloom.
tooltip.luxium.kawase_bloom_depth_occlus: Rejects blurred source samples hidden behind nearer blocks so bloom does not bleed through geometry.
tooltip.luxium.kawase_bloom_depth_tolera: Permitted view-space depth difference at geometry edges. Raise only if the bloom edge is cut too aggressively.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_enabled: Enables screen-space volumetric rays originating from the Sun and Moon.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_sun_size: Controls sun disc and halo size in Sky God Rays.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_moon_size: Controls moon disc and halo size in Sky God Rays.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_celestial_dis: Adds a small separated cinematic disc highlight without swallowing the vanilla Sun or Moon texture.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_halo: Adds a separate atmospheric halo around the Sun and Moon, strongest near sunrise, sunset and hazy weather.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_visual_preset: Cycles between the default visual tuning, a more cinematic look, and custom values created by manually moving the sliders below.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_ray_intensity: Controls how strong the sky shafts are overall.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_halo_intensit: Controls how strong the separate Sun and Moon halo is.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_disc_intensit: Controls how strong the small separated Sun and Moon disc highlight is.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_halo_size: Controls how wide the Sun and Moon halo spreads.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_disc_size: Controls the size of the separated Sun and Moon disc highlight.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_sun_day_color: HEX color used for the high daytime sun.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_sunset_color: HEX color used for sunrise and sunset sun lighting.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_moon_base_col: HEX color used for the base moon lighting.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_moon_halo_col: HEX color used for the moon halo lighting.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_weather_influ: Controls how strongly rain, thunder and haze affect the look.
tooltip.luxium.sky_godrays_center_suppre: Keeps the center cleaner so the vanilla Sun and Moon texture stays readable.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_enabled: Enables the cinematic lens flare effect. Works both with and without Sky God Rays.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_intensity: Controls the overall strength and transparency of the entire lens flare effect.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_streak_intensi: Controls the brightness of the horizontal cinematic streak only.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_streak_length: Controls how far the horizontal streak stretches across the screen.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_streak_width: Controls how thick the horizontal streak appears.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_chromatic_spre: Controls how strongly the flare splits into red, green and blue.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_ghost_intensit: Controls how visible the circular lens ghosts are separately from the streak.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_ghost_size: Controls the size of the circular lens ghosts.
tooltip.luxium.lens_flare_spread: Controls how widely the flare ghosts are distributed across the screen.
tooltip.luxium.fog_celestial_scattering_: Toggles sun and moon scattering glow in fog pass. Works even when fog is off.
tooltip.luxium.block_light_test_enabled: Experimental vanilla-propagated colored light. Replaces other Luxium local lighting modes while enabled.
screen.luxium.alpha_warning.title: Luxium Alpha Warning
screen.luxium.alpha_warning.line1: This is an early alpha — a prototype, not a finished modification.
screen.luxium.alpha_warning.line2: You may experience: crashes, lag, freezes, graphical glitches, and various bugs.
screen.luxium.alpha_warning.line3: Many mechanics are experimental, not ready for gameplay
screen.luxium.alpha_warning.line4: Most of them are in the not playable folder
screen.luxium.alpha_warning.line5: The mod is in active development — it will keep improving.
folder.luxium.not_ready_to_play_dev.desc: THIS IS IN DEVELOPMENT. It contains many bugs, unfinished parts, and experimental features. Feel free to try it, but expect bugs.
tooltip.luxium.tonemap_exposure: Exposure compensation in stops before the filmic curve.
tooltip.luxium.tonemap_contrast: Increases midtone contrast without hard highlight clipping.
tooltip.luxium.tonemap_highlight_compres: Smoothly rolls off bright areas instead of clipping them to flat white.
tooltip.luxium.tonemap_shadow_depth: Slightly deepens flat shadows while preserving detail.
tooltip.luxium.tonemap_saturation: Overall saturation multiplier after the filmic curve.
tooltip.luxium.tonemap_vibrance: Boosts muted colors more strongly than colors that are already saturated.
tooltip.luxium.tonemap_gamma: Gamma used to linearize and encode the image around the filmic operation.
tooltip.luxium.tonemap_strength: Blends between the original image and the tonemapped result.
tooltip.luxium.fog_start_distance: Distance from the camera before fog begins
tooltip.luxium.fog_near_fade: Distance over which fog reaches full local strength after its start point. Set 0 for an almost immediate start; larger values create a softer clear area around the camera.
tooltip.luxium.fog_max_opacity: Caps distant fog opacity so it cannot become a flat white wall.
tooltip.luxium.fog_sky_tint: How strongly fog inherits the blue sky gradient instead of neutral gray.
tooltip.luxium.fog_scattering_strength: Intensity of directional Sun and Moon glow inside the fog. Extended up to 5x.
tooltip.luxium.fog_distance_curve: Controls where density becomes visible. Below 1.0 makes fog strong inside nearby chunks; above 1.0 keeps the foreground clearer.
tooltip.luxium.fog_scattering_brightness: Controls how bright the fog color appears independently from its density.
tooltip.luxium.fog_max_brightness: Caps fog luminance while preserving hue, preventing dense fog from becoming a white wall.
tooltip.luxium.fog_near_density_boost: Adds extra density inside nearby chunks without changing the distant fog color.
tooltip.luxium.fog_near_boost_range: Controls the distance over which the nearby density boost builds up.
tooltip.luxium.fog_dynamic_celestial_col: Uses Celestial Lighting colors for fog. Dawn and sunset become gently warm, daytime follows the sky, and night follows moonlight.
tooltip.luxium.fog_celestial_color_blend: Controls how strongly the shared Celestial Lighting color is mixed into fog.
tooltip.luxium.fog_height: Vertical thickness of the fog layer in blocks. Lower values keep fog closer to the ground; higher values let it extend farther upward. Range: 50–384 blocks.
tooltip.luxium.gpu_local_lighting_mode: GPU Only: local lighting works without NeoFlood. Hybrid: GPU local lights handle the near field while NeoFlood remains available for the transition and outer field. NeoFlood Only bypasses GPU local lighting and uses the clean NeoFlood block-lighting pipeline.
tooltip.luxium.gpu_local_light_distance: Maximum camera distance for GPU local lights
tooltip.luxium.gpu_local_shadow_mode: Legacy GPU local-shadow renderer: Cubemap Hard keeps precise hard shadows and Cubemap PCSS keeps the expensive soft-shadow path. Fast Spread moved to Vanilla GPU → Fast GPU Shadows and is no longer used here.
tooltip.luxium.gpu_hard_shadow_bake_enab: Bake the Cubemap Hard look into six directional RGB receiver textures. After the bake, draw cost no longer grows with source count: a normal block face uses one texture lookup and an arbitrary normal uses up to three. While enabled, PCSS and entity shadow casting are forced off and their controls are disabled.
tooltip.luxium.gpu_hard_shadow_capture_b: Maximum cubemap faces captured per frame while baked hard shadows are being prepared (1–300). Higher values finish source captures and receiver baking sooner but create a larger one-time GPU spike. It has no FPS cost after the bake is complete.
tooltip.luxium.gpu_fast_spread_max_light: Maximum nearest sources used by Cubemap Hard, baked Cubemap Hard, and PCSS.
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_enabled: Use full vanilla block-light propagation and clip occluded local light through a baked GPU visibility volume. NeoFlood, NeoCPU and legacy GPU local lighting stay installed but are inactive while this is enabled.
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_distance: Maximum distance used when selecting non-lava light sources for the camera-centred baked volume.
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_capture_b: Maximum cubemap faces captured per rendered frame. One is smoothest; two fills new areas faster. Each six-face light is spread across multiple frames to avoid GPU spikes.
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_max_sourc: Maximum nearest sources baked into the current volume. The cubemap capture tile size adapts automatically so all slider values up to 40 are honored
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_cutout_en: Allow leaves, grass and other alpha-tested terrain to receive and cast NeoGpuVanilla shadows
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_geometry_: Refresh nearby source captures when blocks change. Disable only for static-scene testing.
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_debug: Log NeoGpuVanilla GPU diagnostics once per second to latest.log using asynchronous timer queries: capture ms, fine-bake ms, dirty/captured faces, sources, bake count, and pixels per block.
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_fast_shad: Bakes the legacy Fast GPU Shadows look directly into NeoGpuVanilla: source colors, exponential attenuation, wrapped diffuse response and local occlusion. Runtime has no per-light loop, so draw cost does not grow from 4 to 40 sources.
Strength multiplier for baked colored local light. 1.00x matches the legacy Fast GPU Shadows intensity.
tooltip.luxium.neo_gpu_vanilla_fast_diff: Wrapped diffuse response for local light. 0.16 matches the legacy Fast GPU Shadows shader; higher values wrap light farther around angled surfaces.
category.luxium.water.description: WATER IS ENABLED BY DEFAULT, BUT IT IS NOT VERY WELL OPTIMIZED YET, THERE WILL BE FPS DROPS. IF YOUR FPS DROPS, IT'S BETTER TO DISABLE SSR, IT USES A LOT OF RESOURCES.
tooltip.luxium.water_depth_aware_refract: Rejects distorted screen samples that belong to geometry in front of the water surface, reducing edge leaks.
tooltip.luxium.water_wave_strength: Controls how strongly the procedural waves bend the surface normal. Does not move water vertices.
tooltip.luxium.water_detail_strength: Controls the contribution of the optional fine detail wave band.
tooltip.luxium.water_absorption_strength: Controls wavelength-dependent Beer-Lambert absorption. Higher values make deep water gain color faster.
tooltip.luxium.water_visibility_depth: Approximate depth in blocks over which the water transitions from clear shallow water to its deep-water color.
tooltip.luxium.water_fresnel_strength: Controls the stronger surface response at grazing viewing angles and contributes to SSR reflection weighting.
tooltip.luxium.water_fresnel_power: Shapes how quickly the grazing-angle surface response grows toward the horizon.
tooltip.luxium.water_surface_opacity: Minimum amount of surface tint mixed over the refracted scene.
tooltip.luxium.water_specular_strength: Controls the physically-inspired sun/moon microfacet glint
tooltip.luxium.water_specular_sharpness: Controls microfacet roughness of the sun/moon glint. Higher values produce a tighter reflection streak
tooltip.luxium.water_ssr_strength: Controls how strongly valid screen-space reflection
tooltip.luxium.water_ssr_max_distance: Maximum view-space ray distance in blocks
tooltip.luxium.water_ssr_thickness: Depth tolerance for accepting a reflected ray hit
tooltip.luxium.water_ssr_edge_fade: Width of the confidence fade near screen borders, hiding the natural screen-space cutoff when a reflected ray leaves the visible scene.
tooltip.luxium.ssr_quality: Global screen-space reflection ray quality shared by Water SSR, Rain Puddle SSR, and Wet Surfaces SSR.
description.luxium.rain_puddles: To test a puddle, stand on a block and type /rainnew "size"
tooltip.luxium.puddle_max_depth: Maximum virtual water depth in blocks
tooltip.luxium.puddle_depth_curve: Shapes how grayscale values become virtual depth
tooltip.luxium.puddle_wet_darkening: Darkens the underlying block through the wet fringe and puddle body so the surface reads as soaked instead of as a transparent mirror decal.
tooltip.luxium.puddle_surface_opacity: Controls how strongly the puddle material covers the original block after depth, refraction, wetness, Fresnel, and SSR are evaluated.
tooltip.luxium.puddle_edge_softness: Controls the width of the transition from dry block to damp fringe to visible water
tooltip.luxium.puddle_wave_strength: Strength of the packed Luxium water micro-normal field on puddles
tooltip.luxium.puddle_wave_scale: Spatial frequency of small puddle ripples
tooltip.luxium.puddle_wave_speed: Animation speed of the moving micro-normal layers used by the puddle surface.
tooltip.luxium.puddle_ripple_strength: Strength of cheap procedural circular rings that simulate raindrop impacts without another texture or particle pass.
tooltip.luxium.puddle_refraction_strengt: Distorts the captured scene under the puddle according to the local virtual depth and surface normal.
tooltip.luxium.puddle_ssr_enabled: Enables non-planar screen-space reflections for /rainnew puddles
tooltip.luxium.puddle_ssr_strength: Controls the contribution of valid puddle SSR hits after Fresnel, distance, thickness, and screen-edge confidence.
tooltip.luxium.puddle_ssr_max_distance: Maximum reflected ray length in blocks
tooltip.luxium.puddle_ssr_thickness: Depth-crossing tolerance for accepting a puddle reflection hit
tooltip.luxium.puddle_ssr_edge_fade: Fades reflection confidence near the screen border where screen-space rays naturally run out of visible information.
description.luxium.wet: Applies Luxium wet-film shading to visible upward-facing SOLID terrain surfaces
tooltip.luxium.wet_enabled: Applies the puddle-style wet material to visible upward-facing SOLID terrain
tooltip.luxium.wet_max_depth: Optical wet-film depth used for refraction and depth-driven shading
tooltip.luxium.wet_darkening: Darkens the original terrain under the wet film so solid blocks read as soaked rather than simply glossy.
tooltip.luxium.wet_surface_opacity: Controls how strongly the wet material covers the original terrain after refraction, wetness, Fresnel, and SSR are evaluated.
tooltip.luxium.wet_edge_softness: Controls how softly the effect accepts nearly-horizontal top surfaces around geometric edges while still rejecting walls and undersides.
tooltip.luxium.wet_wave_strength: Strength of the shared Luxium packed micro-normal field on wet terrain
tooltip.luxium.wet_wave_scale: Spatial frequency of the small moving wet-surface ripples.
tooltip.luxium.wet_wave_speed: Animation speed of the moving micro-normal layers on Wet Surfaces.
tooltip.luxium.wet_ripple_strength: Strength of the same cheap procedural circular raindrop rings used by the new puddle material.
tooltip.luxium.wet_refraction_strength: Distorts the captured terrain color through the virtual wet film according to depth and the wet surface normal.
tooltip.luxium.wet_ssr_enabled: Enables non-planar screen-space reflections on globally wet terrain
tooltip.luxium.wet_ssr_strength: Controls valid Wet Surfaces SSR contribution after Fresnel and confidence weighting.
tooltip.luxium.wet_ssr_max_distance: Maximum reflected ray distance in blocks
tooltip.luxium.wet_ssr_thickness: Depth-crossing tolerance for accepting Wet Surfaces reflection hits.
tooltip.luxium.wet_ssr_edge_fade: Fades Wet Surfaces SSR near screen borders where screen-space rays run out of visible information.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_e: Enables Volumetric Rays. For them to work, NeoSkyCelestia needs to be enabled
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_i: Controls the overall brightness of the 3D volumetric shafts.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_d: Controls how much illuminated atmosphere accumulates along the camera ray. Higher values make shafts denser.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_u: 0% keeps natural path-length accumulation, so shorter rays are weaker. 100% equalizes fully lit shaft brightness across distance while preserving 3D shadow-map occlusion.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_m: Maximum raymarch distance in blocks. The effect is automatically capped by the far sky-shadow cascade coverage.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_a: Controls forward scattering. Higher values concentrate the strongest shafts around the Sun or Moon direction.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_c: 0% keeps rays white; 100% fully uses the current Celestial Lighting direct color, including sunrise, sunset and moonlight.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_s: Controls how readable volumetric shafts remain from side angles. 0% keeps the original strongly directional scattering; 100% boosts weak side-angle scattering without reducing the forward-facing highlight.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_h: Suppresses broad, uniform volumetric haze without simply lowering Ray Intensity. 0% preserves the original volumetric output. Higher values increasingly remove blanket-like screen tint caused by strong Ray Uniformity and Side Visibility in open views, while preserving the physical directional component and shadow-structured shafts. This control is independent from Auto Adaptation. Default: 40%.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_e: Allows entities to block Sky Volumetric God Rays using the NeoSkyCelestia entity shadow map. Requires Entity Shadows in NeoSkyCelestia.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_s: Controls sparse volumetric shadow-map samples per pixel. 8 is fastest, 16 is the recommended balance, and 32 matches the original maximum-quality sampling.
category.luxium.tfr.description: Temporal Frame Reprojection (TFR) reconstructs every second world frame from the previous real frame using depth and current camera movement. May increase FPS
tooltip.luxium.tfr_enabled: Temporal Frame Reprojection (TFR) reconstructs every second world frame from the previous real frame using depth and current camera movement. May increase FPS
tooltip.luxium.tfr_reprojection_strength: How strongly synthetic frames follow current camera movement using the previous real depth buffer. 1.00 is full reprojection. Lower values reduce warp artifacts but increase visible image lag and ghosting.
tooltip.luxium.tfr_history_stability: Spatially filters around the already reprojected sample. Higher values can calm edge shimmer without mixing the old unwarped screen position, so camera pans no longer gain an intentional temporal trail.
tooltip.luxium.tfr_camera_cut_distance: If the camera moves farther than this from the last real frame, Luxium forces a real render instead of using an unreliable synthetic frame.
tooltip.luxium.tfr_camera_cut_angle: If camera rotation exceeds this angle from the last real frame, forces a real render to avoid severe smearing after fast turns or camera cuts.
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_a: Automatically adapts only Ray Uniformity and Side Visibility to the vanilla SKY light level at the camera
tooltip.luxium.sky_volumetric_god_rays_f: Sets the vanilla SKY light level at or below which Auto Adaptation has fully raised Ray Uniformity and Side Visibility to 100%
category.luxium.lsr.description: Luxium Spatial Resolution (LSR), render scale of the whole game
description.luxium.clouds: Vanilla-style clouds, but makes 3 layers of clouds.
tooltip.luxium.clouds_enabled: Enables vanilla-style clouds, but makes 3 layers of clouds.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_layer_enabled: Enables or disables only this cloud layer
tooltip.luxium.cloud_height: Absolute world Y height of this cloud layer.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_speed: Movement speed relative to vanilla clouds. 1.00x is vanilla speed, 0 stops the layer, and higher values move it faster.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_scale: Horizontal size of the vanilla cloud pattern. Below 1 makes cloud features smaller and busier; above 1 makes larger, broader masses and stronger parallax between layers.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_opacity: Transparency of this layer. 0% is invisible; 100% is fully opaque wherever the cloud mask exists.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_thickness: Vertical thickness of Fancy clouds in blocks. Minecraft Fast clouds remain a flat sheet, matching vanilla behavior.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_brightness: Brightness multiplier applied on top of Minecraft's normal time-of-day, rain and thunder cloud color.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_coverage: Controls how much of the sky the layer occupies. Around 50% preserves the vanilla mask. Lower values erode clouds into smaller pieces; higher values fatten and join them. Near 100% can produce a nearly overcast sheet.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_edge_softness: Feathers the binary vanilla cloud edge in source-texture pixels. 0 keeps crisp vanilla pixel edges; higher values make the silhouette softer and more diffuse.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_variation: Adds seamless large/small periodic variation to the coverage boundary
tooltip.luxium.cloud_weather_influence: How strongly rain and thunder increase this layer's coverage toward 100%. At 100%, a full storm drives the layer toward overcast; at 0%, weather does not change its fullness.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_storm_darkening: Extra darkening applied as rain/thunder becomes stronger, in addition to Minecraft's normal weather cloud color. Useful for heavy, gloomy storm layers.
tooltip.luxium.cloud_render_distance: Approximate horizontal cloud radius in blocks. Higher values cover more distant sky but build a larger cloud mesh. Very small Pattern Scale values may hit an internal safety cap to avoid extreme geometry sizes.
description.luxium.grass: Vertex wind for vanilla plants, leaves and aquatic vegetation.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_enabled: Enables animated wind deformation for supported vanilla vegetation.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_strength: Overall displacement strength for plant wind.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_speed: Animation speed of the wind field.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_gust_strength: Strength of slower wind gust modulation.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_distance: Maximum camera distance where vegetation is animated.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_grass_strengt: Relative movement strength for grasses, flowers, crops, vines and similar plants.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_leaves_streng: Relative movement strength for leaf blocks.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_aquatic_stren: Relative movement strength for seagrass, kelp and lily pads.
tooltip.luxium.plants_wave_bend_strength: Controls how strongly rooted plants arc downward while bending sideways.
tooltip.luxium.sky_shadow_soft_shadows_e: Use hardware 2x2 PCF filtering for smoother celestial shadow edges with low GPU cost.
